blocks.text: Grade 10 高频词汇 401–500
gothic /'gɒθik/ n. 哥特风格；adj. 哥特式的, 野蛮的
It was a battle for the Gothic Line.
中文语境：这是一场哥特防线之战
ebullience /i'bʌljəns/ n. 沸腾, 热情, 热情洋溢；[医] 沸腾

But watch out here - this is merely correlational data, not causal, and it's about happiness in the first, "Hollywood" sense I'm going to talk about, happiness of ebullience and giggling and good cheer.
中文语境：但请注意 - 这只是相关数据，而不是因果关系，它是关于第一个幸福感，我要谈论的"好莱坞"感觉，热情洋溢、咯咯笑和欢呼的幸福感
modifiable /'mɒdifaiəbl/ adj. 可修正的, 可变更的, 可修饰的, 可缓和的
The first drawback is, it turns out the pleasant life, your experience of positive emotion, is about 50 percent heritable, and, in fact, not very modifiable.
中文语境：第一个缺点是，事实证明，愉快的生活，即积极情绪的体验，大约有 50% 是可遗传的，而且事实上，不太容易改变
repertoire /'repətwɑː/ n. 全部剧目, 全部技能, 全部节目, 全部作品
Each of them is in a romantic relationship and each has a rich repertoire of friends.
中文语境：他们每个人都处于恋爱关系中，每个人都有丰富的朋友
panoply /'pænəpli/ n. 全套披甲, 全幅盔甲, 华服美饰
And any of you, for free, can go to that website (www.authentichappiness.org) and take the entire panoply of tests of happiness.
中文语境：你们中的任何人都可以免费访问该网站（www.authentichappiness.org）并进行全套幸福测试
sycamore /'sikəmɒː/ n. 西克莫(<<圣经>>故事中的桑树), 悬铃木
An old timer sits under the vermilion sycamore tree
中文语境：朱树下坐老者
caress /kə'res/ n. 爱抚, 拥抱；v.t. 爱抚, 抱, 宠爱
caressing his cheeks with her
中文语境：和她一起抚摸他的脸颊
sanity /'sæniti/ n. 神智健全, 头脑清楚, 通情达理；[医] 精神健全
And again, to balance all this, to bring sanity, to bring normalcy, to get our economic development going, to open up to the world, it's not an easy task.
中文语境：再说一遍，要平衡这一切，要保持理智，要恢复正常，要让我们的经济发展继续下去，要向世界开放，这不是一件容易的事
politically adv. 政治上
But also that there has not been an opening of political space, that Rwanda is not nearly as politically open as many people might like it to be.
中文语境：但政治空间尚未开放，卢旺达在政治上并不像许多人希望的那样开放
intermediary /.intə'miːdiəri/ n. 仲裁者, 调解者, 媒介物, 中间人；adj. 中间的, 媒介的

In certain periods such as war, helots were required to serve in the armed forces and, fighting well, they could even earn an escape from their lot and join the intermediary social groups which existed below the level of full-citizen and included such individuals as children with parents of mixed status (e.g.: father-citizen, mother- helot ).
中文语境：在战争等特定时期，黑劳士被要求参军，如果战斗力出色，他们甚至可以逃脱命运，加入到完全公民水平以下的中间社会群体中，其中包括父母混合身份的儿童（例如：父亲与公民、母亲与黑劳士）
illicit /i'lisit/ adj. 不法的, 不正当的, 禁止的；[法] 违法的, 违禁的, 被禁止的

Women, children, immigrants (both Greek and foreign), laborers, and slaves all had defined roles, but there was interaction (often illicit) between the classes and there was also some movement between social groups, particularly for second generation offspring and during times of stress such as wars.
中文语境：妇女、儿童、移民（希腊和外国）、劳工和奴隶都有明确的角色，但阶级之间存在互动（通常是非法的），社会群体之间也存在一些流动，特别是对于第二代后代和在战争等压力时期
rectify /'rektifai/ v.t. 订正, 矫正, 改正, 调正, 校正, 精馏, 整流；[化] 精馏
He quickly rectified matters.
中文语境：他很快就纠正了问题
acuity /ə'kjuːəti/ n. 尖锐, (疾病的)剧烈, 敏锐；[化] 锐度; 分辨能力
It's difficult to put a number on exactly how much you can expect your mental acuity to slow, particularly if you can't put your mind to the test in a computerized lab.
中文语境：很难准确地计算出你的思维敏锐度会下降多少，特别是如果你不能在计算机化实验室中测试你的思维的话
senile /'siːnail/ adj. 高龄的, 衰老的, 老年期的；[医] 老年的
Conversely, if you become convinced that you're getting "senile" (a terrible word!), you can accelerate your psychological aging clock.
中文语境：相反，如果你确信自己正在"衰老"（一个可怕的词！），你的心理衰老时钟就会加速
subtract /səb'trækt/ v.t. 减去, 扣掉, 减少；v.i. 做减法；[计] 减
Being able to subtract a few years from this subjective age, or age that you feel, may actually buy you a few more objective years of healthy and productive life.
中文语境：能够从这个主观年龄或你感觉的年龄中减去几年，实际上可能会给你带来几年更客观的健康和富有成效的生活
smite /smait/ v.t. 重击, 打, 击败, 毁灭, 侵袭, 打动；v.i. 重击, 打；n. 重击, 打
If you find yourself smitten with someone you've only just met, you'll question whether you should give the feeling so much weight - and risk ending up like Michael.
中文语境：如果你发现自己爱上了一个刚刚认识的人，你会质疑是否应该如此重视这种感觉 - 并冒着像迈克尔一样的风险
underhanded /'ʌndə'hændid/ adj. 人手不足的, 秘密的, 卑劣的
Is there an emotional high that people experience when they get away with doing something underhanded?
中文语境：当人们做了不正当的事情而逃脱惩罚时，他们是否会经历一种情绪高涨？
generalize /'dʒenərəlaiz/ v.t. 一般化, 概括, 推广；v.i. 形成概念, 笼统讲

While the research is based on experiments that may not generalize to the real world, Nicole Ruedy and her fellow researchers suggest that emotions play a stronger role in ethical decision-making than conventional models seem willing to acknowledge.
中文语境：虽然这项研究基于可能无法推广到现实世界的实验，但 Nicole Ruedy 和她的研究人员同事认为，情绪在道德决策中发挥的作用比传统模型似乎愿意承认的更重要
evasion /i'veiʒən/ n. 逃避, 藉口；[法] 回避, 规避, 逃避
But what about relatively victimless crimes such as computer piracy, tax evasion, insurance fraud, or cheating on tests?
中文语境：但是对于计算机盗版、逃税、保险欺诈或考试作弊等相对无受害者的犯罪呢？
heady /'hedi/ adj. 顽固的, 任性的, 性急的, 猛烈的
I was heady with happiness.
中文语境：我欣喜若狂
marginal /'mɑːdʒinəl/ adj. 边缘的, 最低限度的, 有旁注的；[医] 缘的
Though the "high" was often only marginal, the feeling of having "gotten away" with cheating seems to override feelings of guilt or shame at cheating.
中文语境：虽然"兴奋"往往只是微不足道的，但"摆脱"作弊的感觉似乎压倒了因作弊而产生的内疚或羞耻感
redress /ri'dres/ n. 赔偿, 补救, 矫正；v.t. 纠正, 赔偿, 救济

That suffering contributes to social ills that now plague Indian communities, said Denise Lajimodiere, a board member of the Colorado-based National Native American Boarding School Healing Coalition, which seeks redress.
中文语境：科罗拉多州全国原住民寄宿学校治疗联盟董事会成员丹尼斯·拉吉莫迪埃 (Denise Lajimodiere) 表示，这种痛苦加剧了现在困扰印第安社区的社会弊病，该联盟寻求补救
liquefy /'likwifai/ v. (使)溶解, (使)液化
The last thing that happens after the caterpillar begins to liquefy is its head pops off.
中文语境：毛毛虫开始液化后发生的最后一件事是它的头弹出
innermost /'inəməust/ adj. 内心的, 秘密的, 最深处的
It's just dealing with its innermost depths.
中文语境：它只是处理其最深处的问题
prong /prɒŋ/ n. 叉状物, 耙子；v.t. 刺, 贯穿, 翻掘
When I think about how we've gotten to this place of being so separated from the earth and from each other and from our choices, it seems like there's many prongs that have gotten us to this point.
中文语境：当我想到我们是如何走到这个与地球、彼此以及我们的选择如此分离的地方时，似乎有很多因素让我们走到了这一步
manifestation /.mænifes'teiʃən/ n. 显示, 证明, 示威运动；[医] 表现, 表示
For me the divine is the great mystery, that we are all manifestations of this great mystery.
中文语境：对我来说，神圣是伟大的奥秘，我们都是这个伟大奥秘的表现
profound /prə'faund/ adj. 极深的, 深厚的, 深刻的, 渊博的
And fear is simple and profound, just like love is simple and profound.
中文语境：恐惧是简单而深刻的，就像爱是简单而深刻的一样
illustrative /'iləstrətiv/ adj. 说明的, 解说的, 作例证的
Karen: So, this is really illustrative of what happened.
中文语境：凯伦：所以，这确实说明了所发生的事情
pamper /'pæmpə/ v.t. 放纵, 使吃饱, 使过量
Harless: Congressman Harless of Arizona calls the Nazi prisoners of the United States pampered and privileged!
中文语境：哈勒斯：亚利桑那州国会议员哈勒斯称美国的纳粹囚犯被宠坏了，享有特权！
perverse /pə'vəːs/ adj. 乖张的, 故意作对的, 有悖常情的, 执迷不悟的, 歪曲的, 错误的, 不正当的；[法] 邪恶的, 罪恶的:堕落的, 不合法的
Jad: I mean is it really true, that all the niceness was just a perverse form of racism?
中文语境：Jad：我的意思是，所有的友善只是一种反常的种族主义形式，这真的是真的吗？
obstruct /əb'strʌkt/ v.t. 阻隔, 妨碍, 阻塞, 遮没；v.i. 设障碍

And be it further enacted, That any person who shall knowingly and willingly obstruct or hinder such claimant, his agent, or attorney, in so seizing or arresting such fugitive from labor, or shall rescue such fugitive from such claimant, his agent or attorney, when so arrested pursuant to...
中文语境：进一步规定，任何人若故意并故意阻碍或妨碍该原告、其代理人或律师扣押或逮捕该劳工逃犯，或在根据......
incur /in'kəː/ v.t. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇；[经] 招致, 蒙受, 担负

...in court agent shall appear within six months from the time of the arrest, the prisoner may be discharged: and all costs or expenses incurred in the apprehending, securing, and transmitting such fugitive to the State or Territory making such demand, shall be paid by such State or Territory.
中文语境：...出庭代理人应在逮捕后六个月内出庭，囚犯可被释放：在逮捕、保护该逃犯并将其移送至提出此类要求的国家或地区时产生的所有费用或开支，应由该国家或地区支付
warrant /'wɒːrənt/ n. 授权, 正当理由, 根据, 证明, 批准, 凭证, 令状, 委任状；v.t. 授权给, 保证, 担保, 批准, 使有正当理由

...duty of such Judge or magistrate to give a certificate thereof to such claimant, his agent, or attorney, which shall be sufficient warrant for removing the said fugitive from labor to the State or Territory from which he or she fled.
中文语境：...该法官或治安法官有责任向该原告、其代理人或律师提供证明，该证明应足以作为将该逃犯从劳工中转移到他或她逃离的州或地区的依据
shunt /ʃʌnt/ v.t. 使转轨, 使分流, 回避讨论, 推延；v.i. 转向一边, 转轨, 往返；n. 转轨, 分流
A full 95 percent of Black veterans were shunted off to Black colleges-institutions that were underfunded and overwhelmed by the influx of new students.
中文语境：整整 95% 的黑人退伍军人被分流到资金不足且因新生涌入而不堪重负的黑人大学机构
virulent /'virjulənt/ adj. 剧毒的, 致命的, 刻毒的, 恶毒的, 恶性的, 有病毒的, 过强的；[医] 有毒力的, 毒性的

Rankin was known for his virulent racism: He defended segregation, opposed interracial marriage, and had even proposed legislation to confine, then deport, every person with Japanese heritage during World War II.
中文语境：兰金以其恶毒的种族主义而闻名：他捍卫种族隔离，反对异族通婚，甚至在二战期间提出立法限制所有有日本血统的人，然后驱逐出境
glutinous /'gluːtinəs/ adj. 粘性的；[医] 胶状的, 粘的
For a plate of turtle, green and glutinous.)
中文语境：来一盘甲鱼，又绿又糯。）
piebald /'paibɒːld/ adj. 花斑的, 杂色的, 杂种的；n. 花斑马
With idle pipe and vesture piebald?
中文语境：有闲置的管道和服装花斑？
ribald /'ribɒːld/ adj. 说话猥亵的, 下流的, 粗俗的；n. 说下流话的人
Insulted by a lazy ribald
中文语境：被一个懒惰下流的人侮辱
sacrilege /'sækrilidʒ/ n. 亵渎圣物, 冒渎, 渎圣行为；[法] 橇门入教堂行窃, 窃取圣物
It's sacrilege to tamper with stuff like this.
中文语境：篡改这样的东西是一种亵渎
muffler /'mʌflə/ n. 围巾, 头巾, 无指手套, 消声器；[化] 消声器; 消音器
It gave him a feeling of deep, solid satisfaction to be planted there in the midst of it in full view of that frail old figure in the muffler.
中文语境：置身于其中，清楚地看到围着消音器的那个虚弱的老身影，这给了他一种深深的、坚实的满足感
tamper /'tæmpə/ v.i. 干预, 拨弄, 贿赂, 损害, 篡改；v.t. 篡改；n. 捣棒, 打夯机, 填塞者
It's sacrilege to tamper with stuff like this.
中文语境：篡改这样的东西是一种亵渎
dreary /'driəri/ adj. 沉闷的
How dreary - to be - Somebody!
中文语境：多么沉闷--某人！
advertise /'ædvətaiz/ v.t. 做广告, 通知, 公布；v.i. 做广告
they'd advertise - you know!
中文语境：他们会做广告 - 你知道！
compliant /kəm'plaiənt/ adj. 顺从的, 屈从的；[电] 适用于, 配合...使用
The first is a compliant false confession.
中文语境：第一个是顺从的虚假供述
flunk /flʌŋk/ n. 失败, 不及格；v.i. 失败, 考试不及格, 放弃；v.t. 使不及格
"They tell them that their fingerprints were at the scene when they weren't, that they flunked a polygraph when they didn't, that an eye witness saw them do it when there is no such person.
中文语境："他们告诉他们，他们的指纹在现场，而他们并不在现场；他们没有通过测谎仪，而他们却没有通过；当没有这样的人时，目击者看到他们这样做
interrogation /in.terəu'geiʃən/ n. 审问, 疑问句, 问号；[电] 询问
"Many of these interrogations involve these extreme techniques," says study coauthor Elizabeth Loftus, a psychology and social behavior professor at the University of California, Irvine.
中文语境："许多审讯都涉及这些极端的技术，"研究合著者、加州大学欧文分校心理学和社会行为教授伊丽莎白·洛夫特斯说
serial /'siəriəl/ n. 分期连载作品, 连载小说；adj. 连续的, 一连串的, 连载的, 分期偿还的；[计] 连续的; 串行的
That ambiguity can lead to a shocking number of wrongful convictions, as dissections of high-profile trials in the NPR podcast Serial and the Netflix documentary Making a Murderer reveal.
中文语境：正如 NPR 播客 Serial 和 Netflix 纪录片《制作杀人犯》中对备受瞩目的审判的剖析所揭示的那样，这种模糊性可能会导致数量惊人的错误定罪
detonate /'detəneit/ v.t. 引爆, 使爆炸, 使爆裂；v.i. 爆炸, 发爆炸声
and Soviet Union detonated so many bombs that they changed the concentration of carbon-14 in the atmosphere by a factor of two.
中文语境：和苏联引爆了如此多的炸弹，导致大气中碳14的浓度改变了两倍
seminar /'seminɑː/ n. 研究班, 专题讨论会；[经] 讨论会, 专家讨论会
"We need to bring out the history, and that's the point of the seminar, is that it's not a benign sort of undertaking," explains Gover.
中文语境："我们需要揭示历史，这就是研讨会的重点，这不是一项良性的事业，"戈弗解释道
incongruous /in'kɒŋgruəs/ adj. 不协调的, 不一致的, 不合适的

Gover, who today is the director of the American Indian Museum, says he remembers thinking, "I couldn't quite understand why an Indian would get up and dance when the Sooners scored a touchdown." Of Pawnee heritage, Gover says he understands now that the use of Indian names and imagery for mascots is more than just incongruous.
中文语境：戈弗现在是美国印第安人博物馆馆长，他说他记得当时的想法："我不太明白为什么当捷者队触地得分时印第安人会站起来跳舞。"关于波尼族的传统，戈弗表示，他现在明白，使用印度名字和图像作为吉祥物不仅仅是不协调
quibble /'kwibl/ n. 遁词, 双关语；v.i. 吹毛求疵, 争吵, 说模棱两可的话；v.t. 对...诡辩

Why should we hesitate or why should we quibble or why should we quarrel with one another to find out what the difficulty is, when we know what the Lord told us what the difficulty is, and Moses wrote it out so a blind man could see it, then Jesus told us all about it, and it was later written in the Book of James, where everyone could read it?
中文语境：当我们知道主告诉我们困难是什么，摩西把它写下来让盲人也能看到，然后耶稣告诉我们这一切，后来写在《雅各书》里，每个人都可以读到的时候，我们为什么要犹豫，为什么要狡辩，为什么要互相争吵来找出困难是什么？
remission /ri'miʃən/ n. 宽恕, 豁免, 免罪, 缓和, 减轻；[医] 缓解, 弛张
"Then," said the Lord, in effect, "every seventh year there shall be a remission of debts; there will be no debts after 7 years." That was the law.
中文语境："那么，"主说，实际上，"每第七年债务就会减免一次；七年后就没有债务了。"这就是法律
belabor /bi'leibə/ v.t. 痛打；[法] 殴打, 鞭打, 辱骂

Now, ladies and gentlemen, if I may proceed to give you some other words that I think you can understand - I am not going to belabor you by quoting tonight - I am going to tell you what the wise men of all ages and all times, down even to the present day, have all said: That you must keep the wealth of the country scattered, and you...
中文语境：现在，女士们先生们，如果我可以继续给你们一些我认为你们能理解的其他的话--我今晚不会引用来折磨你们--我要告诉你们各个时代、各个时代、甚至直到今天的智者都说过的话：你们必须分散国家的财富，你们......
caprice /kə'priːs/ n. 反复无常, 多变, 任性

Every man a king, so there would be no such thing as a man or woman who did not have the necessities of life, who would not be dependent upon the whims and caprices and ipsi dixit of the financial martyrs for a living.
中文语境：每个人都是国王，所以没有一个男人或女人没有生活必需品，不会依赖金融烈士的突发奇想、反复无常和伊普西迪克西特来谋生
dividend /'dividend/ n. 被除数, 股利；[计] 被除数
Drawing no dividend from time's to-morrows.
中文语境：不从明天的时间中汲取红利
trench /trentʃ/ n. 渠, 沟渠, 战壕；v.t. 在...开沟, 挖战壕于, 用战壕围住；v.i. 挖战壕, 开沟
And in the ruined trenches, lashed with rain,
中文语境：在被雨水冲刷的毁坏的战壕里，
